title: Crisis of Servanthood
body:
As-salaamu `alaykum yaa ayyuha 'l-humaqaa! Heedless ones, idiotic ones, and mental house ones from east
to west, from north to south. No-mind people, no-thinking people, not taking any wisdom! Allah Almighty is
giving Mankind understanding and wisdom, but they are not using it.
O People! As-salaamu `alaykum. Don't be idiotic ones, try to be awakened people! We must try, because
although we are weak servants, the Lord of Heavens is giving us such power to defend our real beings. Our
real being is on the target of Shaytan and his followers; their real target is to keep Mankind from taking
honor and their dressing the Creator granted them. We are asking for forgiveness from the Seal of Prophets
(s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Zidhu yaa Rabbee `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa surooran sultaanan wa
ridwaana. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Also for all prophets and heavenly ones on this planet, on Earth.
Shaytan's followers are running from east to west, from north to south, to make people fall into bad
conditions and finally into a black hole. Any big, small, or medium sized star, even galaxies, that come near a
black hole disappears and no one knows where they went to, finished. People are observing only black holes
in space, but in this world you can find different sizes of black holes everywhere, attracting people to them
although they are never apparent. Therefore, we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem (Mawlana Shaykh sits).

••••• •••••
Ad-deenu naseeha, "Islam is advice."
Islam is teaching people good ways and calling them to a good future here and Hereafter. Also, Islam is
warning, "O People! Around you are countless black tunnels." They may see black holes in space, but here in
this world they are not talking of black holes, although we may say "black tunnels", nafaq. They are making so
many ornaments at the entrance of those black tunnels and Shaytan is calling, "O People! It is free, free,
free!" People see so many ornaments there, and when they approach the magnetic power sends them inside
and they are finished. All prophets came to wake people up and make everything around them clear.
We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. We must always say, a`oodhu billahi min ashShaytani 'r-rajeem, because Shaytan and those shaytanic groups are carrying people to such terrible ends that
they are never seen in existence again. It is a chance that has been granted once; keep it well. If you lose it,
there is no second chance for people to come to this life. They will ask, "O Rabbee, send us once again and we
will be Your obedient servants, keeping Your orders!" But no, the answer comes, "You will be there for
Eternity!" Allah Almighty creates and what He created is coming into existence and then leaving. Some of
them are running into shining tunnels, and they will not be advertisers at the entrance of shaytanic or dark
tunnels. There will be very few people coming there, according to prophets' advice. If one thousand, one
million, one billion, or one trillion people are entering it, the outlook is so dark. But prophets' advice is to
accept heavenly orders and they are defending the prophets' invitation. It appears so difficult, so people are
running to the tunnel with the shining entrance, but after passing through they reach a dark tunnel such that
no one knows where it will end.
But at that second tunnel no one is looking or interested, because it appears to be so difficult. Believers are
running into it, passing through a passage, and then an opening to Eternity comes. And people in this life are
going to be tested, but mostly people are not using their mentalities or good will, and they are following their
egoistic pleasures and running in it and falling in endless dark tunnels.
O People! We must think on it because no one is living here forever. Billions of people are just coming on this
planet, dunya, and disappearing. May Allah Almighty protect us! Don't think that everyday the same people

are running in the streets, no! Try to follow heavenly ones' advice. Holy ones are those who belong to the
Lord of Heavens' servanthood. Try also to be servants of the Lord of Creation. Servanthood is the highest
rank Man may reach. Follow the way of prophets. Try to follow their followers also; you will always find them
in every time.
O Wahabi people and Salafi `ulamas! Allah Almighty is saying: (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
•••••••• •••• •••••••••••••
Koonu ma` as-saadiqeen, Be with those who are true (in word and deed). (9:119)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) I am asking them to follow that heavenly advice, Koonu ma` as-saadiqeen. It is not
only for the time of Sahaabah (r), it is for all Mankind! Follow true ones, because mostly people have been
cheated by shaytanic agents and are thinking they are on the true way, but they are on the wrong way.
Humanity can't be saved in this century if they do not ask for true ones to follow. If Mankind does not follow
true ones, their final station is going to be those black tunnels. Don't be cheated by Shaytan and it's countless
representatives.
We are asking forgiveness from Allah Almighty!We are in the holy night of Sha`baan Mu`azzam and next
week it will be Holy Ramadan. Try to take shaytanic dressing away from your body; try to dress in heavenly
dress and put on the belt of service. Waiters and servants used this when they were in service. We must try to
put servant's belts on for Allah! Leave that month for Allah Almighty's service. It is one month, and we gave
our oath for our whole life! If we are not doing that, then we must try to keep that service for a limited
number of days in Ramadan and He will accept it. But people are saying, "No we can't be saabireen, among
the patient ones, that we are not eating or drinking in our houses!" And they are not trying to train their rides
for heavenly service. That is from our egos' nafsuka matiyatuk.
O Salafiyoon and Wahhabiyoon! How are you dealing with your ego, nafs? You must deal with your ego as a
person deals with his donkey, carrying a stick in his hand, so if that animal deviates he will hit it, making it go
straight again. And so many strikes are warning, "O People! Come and do your best service for your Lord!"
But people do not understand, saying, "We are trying to give our best service to our rides." Therefore, the
whole world is under a heavy and terrible burden; no one knows what is coming to all people, all nations, and
all tyrants from Heavens. Allah Almighty is not sleeping, haasha! He is saying, "We are not leaving them as

they think, with no one controlling. They think they are uncontrolled creatures. Uncontrolled creatures are
animals, but you are controlled! We are looking at what you are doing and intending.”
And people are saying, "O Shaykh! We are in a very bad economical crisis." Ptuuh (spit) on you and your
"economical crisis"! It is a crisis of servanthood, because they left it and therefore cursing is coming on them!
There are countless kinds of cursing coming on people and only one of those is the economical crisis! It is not
a money problem, it is something else. What they are eating is going to be like poison for them. Everything is
poisoning them, because they are running away from their Creator and leaving their oaths! They are acting
against their oaths and so many kinds of troubles are coming on them and poisoning them. Every forbidden
work or action is a kind of curse, and cursing is the beginning or main reason not to be keeping their oath
with their Lord. So many people's companies are now bankrupt, with no goodness, and they are running after
Shaytan and then crying, "We are in such a bad condition!" You ran into it!
When you forget your oath to Allah Almighty, punishment is coming. Everything is reaching those who are
not keeping their promises, even that virus. O our Lord, yaa Rabbana! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Yaa Sayyidi
'l-awwaleen wa ’l-akhireen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Ishfa` lana yamlikoon thumma zaahiroon.
We are expecting that You are giving good tidings about the last khalifah, Sayyidina Mahdi (a), ajaabana'Llah.
Bi jaahihi `indak bi sirr Surat al-Fatihah.
(40 minutes)
Fatihah
